title: Soft glow but fragile
text:
Soft glow but fragile. These work in theory but I find them to be lower quality than I expected. The container was full of dust from them and many were smashed which makes me worry about durability. The edges are also very sharp.

I used a black light to charge and test them and only the top side would faintly glow, even after sitting under the light for an extended period. I have others that will pick up the glow much easier without the worry about breaking under foot in the garden.
